title: seampact IR: common members
description: Ids, names, origins, docs and extension slots shared by every IR file (ADR 0004 sections 3 and 6).

SchemaId.description: The id of a named schema: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

ScalarId.description: The id of a named scalar: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

EnumId.description: The id of an enum: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

ErrorCode.description: An error code, the key of the errors catalogue (ADR 0004 section 4).

NatureId.description: The id of a contract nature: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

SchemeId.description: The id of a security scheme: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

HeaderId.description: The id of an identity header: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

IdentityId.description: The id of an identity: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

RightId.description: The id of a right: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

RuleId.description: The id of a rule: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

ScopeId.description: The id of a scope: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

BucketId.description: The id of a rate-limit bucket: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

ServiceId.description: The id of a service: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

FormatId.description: The id of a wire format: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

PagingId.description: The id of a paging style: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

SurfaceId.description: The id of an api surface: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

DocumentId.description: The id of an api document: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

VariantId.description: The id of a principal variant: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

DerivationId.description: A derivation id of the derivation table (ADR 0006 section 5), 'pack.<pack>.<entry>' for a pack entry.

Feature.description: A must-understand feature name (ADR 0005 section 3); none is defined at irRevision 1.

Reason.description: The written reason of an exception (A36).

SchemaRef.description: A reference by id to a named object schema of the schemas catalogue (ADR 0004 section 4).

NameRole.description: The role of a name (ADR 0007 section 1).

Name.description: A canonical name: word segments plus a role, never a final identifier (ADR 0007 section 1).

status.description: The HTTP success status of a 'response' name; present if and only if role is 'response' (lead decision, checked by the compiler: the schema subset has no conditional).

additionalProperties.description: A consumer value, kept as raw JSON.

Origin.description: Where an element was declared: a JSON Pointer into the merged authoring tree of its layer (ADR 0004 section 6).

api.description: Set on an element copied from another api by a relay route.

DerivedFrom.description: Present on, and only on, an element the compiler derived (ADR 0004 section 6).

ValueSource.description: Where a value is read (ADR 0004 section 7). 'name' with path, query, header, body, principal and scope; 'prefixBits' only with address.
